summary: Turned the retained run into an account and set up both the formal support and the next lead. The recorded execution (011decb17a314e839b860436ad3dc164, exit 0) reports both cases passed — the unconsumed case required all three event channels full, a permanently parked actor and its append_notify endpoint withheld, and the drained control kept all nodes answering with a follower append_notify Ok — but that receipt has no parsed events, so it cannot be cited as completed support: the answer is now a conditional account with defect_claim asserted, and a revised harness that prints CA_EVENT operands (bound reached, parked node, withheld endpoint, control responsiveness, control append_notify) was submitted as a fresh execution with previous_id/revision_reason. Also registered the next independent lead: the core has no accept-phase resend (leader's Accept branch only resends a pending StopSign and re-Prepares unpremised peers; the follower's Accept arm is empty), so a lost Accepted reply may leave a quorum-accepted entry undecided with no enabled repair until an unrelated proposal — with sources and a deterministic drop-one-message discriminator, no defect claimed before it runs.
